status: Protocol fixed before extended training or evaluation
hypothesis: A longer and stronger policy update can improve stochastic constraint compliance; greedy decoding may not change.
causal_limit: Two training hyperparameters change together; this does not isolate which one matters.
selection: Evaluate only final checkpoint; no validation-based checkpoint selection or additional hyperparameter sweep in this experiment.
validation: All 48 fixed validation tasks, greedy and four independent temperature-1 samples per task, for both SFT and extended GRPO.
primary_metric: Mean per-task fraction of stochastic samples satisfying all six constraints. Report selected best-of-4 separately.
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over task IDs, not individual completions. Conditional on one training seed.
test: After validation, evaluate both fixed policies once on test_id with the same greedy and four-sample settings, regardless of validation outcome. OOD tests remain reserved.
publication: Publish all results, including regressions. No claim of musical quality or multi-seed robustness.
